english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a distinction or a feature that makes two things different.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a distinction or difference between two things.
Use this when diversity focuses on the differences between things rather than variety as a whole.

examples.english: The biggest difference between these two versions is the price.
examples.traditional: 呢兩個版本最大嘅分別係價錢。

examples.traditional: 你要分清楚紅茶同奶茶嘅分別。
